headline.line: The study developed a hybrid model combining a Genetic Algorithm-optimized Backpropagation Neural Network (GA-BPNN) with Bayesian updating to predict the Pavement Quality Index (PQI).

synthesis.paragraph: In today's research, "Deep learning reveals cross-platform consistency in street view imagery for urban perception mapping" shares 5 references with the June 13, 2026 paper "City landscape in sight: A crowdsourced framework for unlocking urban-scale window view perceptions from real estate imagery," including "Perception and aesthetics of the urban environment: Review of the role of vegetation" and "Building instance classification using street view images." Additionally, "15-Minute City and beyond: Linking local and regional accessibility with urban vitality" shares 5 references with the July 2, 2026 paper "Multimodal accessibility and equity in X-minute cities: Insights from neighborhood-level assessments in Singapore," and another 5 references with the July 10, 2026 paper "Urban planning, the built environment, and subjective well-being: A review of recent research advances." These shared references include "15-Minute City: Decomposing the New Urban Planning Eutopia" across both connections. Finally, the University of Toronto appears on 2 of today's papers, while over the last 30 days, Tongji University has appeared on 28 papers, Hong Kong Polytechnic University on 25 papers, Peking University on 19 papers, and Beijing Jiaotong University on 17 papers.
